bio.en: Wilson is a full-stack developer in Loja, Ecuador, and the founder of Kriterio. He builds web and mobile products for clients with React, Next.js, NestJS, Supabase, Firebase and Flutter, and writes every comparison on the site from that day-to-day work.
bio.es: Wilson es desarrollador full-stack en Loja, Ecuador, y fundador de Kriterio. Construye productos web y móviles para clientes con React, Next.js, NestJS, Supabase, Firebase y Flutter, y escribe cada comparativa del sitio desde ese trabajo diario.
